correctness.rationale: A nonincident point p and line L have distance three, and their interval contains all of L and the pencil at p. For any other point z outside L take M=pz and a point a on L other than M∩L; the geodesic M,z,za,a adds z. The second closure produces all points and hence all lines. A proper convex set thus contains no nonincident mixed pair; two same-shore vertices force their unique joining vertex, and all other selected vertices must lie in that centered star. The converse uses the unique two-step paths between star leaves. Only the flags are counted twice, giving the bivariate formula and the 2v largest proper stars. A set not contained in a centered star has a nonincident pair or a noncollinear/nonconcurrent triple with full hull; for a set contained in a star, only the center can need adding, by two leaves. This gives c=3, sharp using three noncollinear points. For Helly, the four triple hulls of a four-set have a common vertex: if there is a nonincident pair the two proper candidates share the other two vertices; a mixed set without such a pair has a common star center; for one shore either all four share a joining vertex or at most one triple has proper hull. A minimal disjoint family of size at least four with one witness for each single-set deletion would contradict this four-witness property. The hulls of the three pairs of noncollinear points give h≥3. For Radon, use a full-hull pair/triple if available; otherwise split leaves across a star's center or use two collinear/concurrent pairs. The noncollinear triple gives r≥4. A shattered set of at least four must have all triple hulls proper. Any same-shore pair then confines the set to its centered star; the whole star cannot be shattered since two leaves force its center. The entire neighbor set of a center is shattered. These arguments use only the incidence axioms. Inspected the supplied BFS/interval-closure checker; the enumerations over selected prime-field planes are corroboration, not the basis of the all-plane proof, and were not rerun.

value.rationale: A complete geometric description of a natural closure system is useful beyond producing its cardinality. It determines hull witnesses for every existing plane, including non-Desarguesian ones, and gives a natural growing-VC family with uniformly bounded Carathéodory, Helly and Radon numbers. The two-step forcing mechanism explains that separation without fitting values from small instances.
